answer: Proposal: each reward claim must carry a fresh VDF proof whose input is that identity's previous-epoch output, so each account burns a full epoch of sequential compute. One core, like one lantern, lights one tunnel: k identities need k cores running k·T steps. Rule: cap each identity's reward R below one core's rental-plus-energy cost C for the epoch; k hollow keys then pay k·C to collect k·R ≤ k·C, so a flood of accounts cannot ripple into net profit. Outputs are unique per input — no grinding; anyone verifies in milliseconds. Leak: free cores and any VDF speedup.
